description: A CI dashboard: the GitHub Actions runs of the repository that you work in, and a form that starts a workflow. Needs gh.

settings.label: Download folder
settings.hint: The folder that gets the artifacts, in <run-id>/<name> folders. Empty: <repo>/.ci-dash/artifacts. A repository on another machine always uses its own folder.

settings.label: Open the folder after a download
settings.hint: Opens the folder of the artifact in the file manager when the download ends.
